tay: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — collecting discrete action owners for regional resilience improvements. I listed items in the tracker, but want ACKs here so we can lock due dates.

tay: Top items: 1) granular restore runbook (table-level + edge cases), 2) multi-region routing playbook with cooling lock, 3) automated backup-validation pipeline + alerts, 4) game-day rehearsal plan + comms.

liam: I'll own the routing playbook. Plan: document BGP pref tests, weighted DNS canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%), and add a 10-min cooling lock to prevent flapping. ETA: 1819070000. Will include a simple smoke test: `curl -sf https://api.eu.example.com/health`.

dina: I'll take the restore runbook and backup validation. Action: add step-by-step table restore examples, CI dry-restore job that runs monthly, checksum comparison, and upload report to artefacts bucket. ETA: 1819055000. Note: will coordinate with @sec for scrub rules.

ops-bot: backup-validator last_run=1818990000 status=partial missing_incr=eu-west-2

sec: Security: any pipeline that pulls snapshots into staging must include a scrub stage. Provide sample scrub script in PR for review; scoped creds will be issued after review.

liam: For routing, I'll also propose a pre-failover capacity check: target_region_cpu < 70% AND free_gpu_slots >= 2. If check fails, abort and escalate to oncall.

dina: For the dry-restore job I'll emit a Prom metric `dr_restore_duration_seconds` and an alert if > 3600s. Also will add a small schema diff to catch incompatibilities.

tay: I've created the tracker: https://redwood.internal/incidents/resilience-actions-2026. Please comment on your row to ACK and set due_ts.

liam: ACK routing playbook assigned. due_ts=1819070000

dina: ACK restore + validation assigned. due_ts=1819055000

sec: We'll review the scrub PR and confirm least-privilege IAM for the CI runner. Also recommend MFA-delete on the artifact bucket.

ops-bot: scheduled_job reminder: backup-validator will run 1819053600

tay: Planning a 2-hour game-day on 1819150000 to exercise runbooks and automation. Volunteers: routing (liam), DB/restore (dina), comms (tay). Confirm availability and I'll send invites.

liam: I'll be there and run the routing steps in staging.

dina: I'll run the restore and measure RTO.

tay: Thanks — I'll mark tracker rows as "in progress" once PRs land. Ping #eng-oncall or @tay for blockers. Reopening thread if owners change. :white_check_mark:
